title: Cleaner text streams and clearer errors
summary:
One text API overhaul tightened streaming and error handling while moving OpenAI-backed requests through a new gateway client.

The merged text API change simplifies streaming responses, tests that streams end with a single SSE [DONE] event, and preserves provider error details in API errors.

Cloudflare requests omit the unsupported seed parameter, and the shared OpenAI-compatible client adds a default system prompt only when the selected model has one configured.

OpenAI model aliases, OpenAI-backed personas, search, and referral processing were moved from a direct Azure OpenAI client to a Portkey gateway client. Request parsing and referrer handling were also consolidated into a shared utility.
